summary: Per-page scroll walk and image-SEO surface for all 15 top-entry pages completed with file:line evidence
findings: IMAGE SITEMAP: None exists. layouts/sitemap.xml uses standard urlset without image namespace (file:14-16). No <image:image> extensions. Image-search surface is unoptimized — no image-specific sitemap anywhere in repo.

OG:IMAGE per page: Template (head.html:58-62) uses .Params.image | default .Site.Params.og_image. All 15 pages have image in frontmatter, so each gets its own og:image. No sharing image inconsistencies found.

ALT-TEXT STRATEGY: Hero-image.html (line 9-11) falls back to .Title when image_alt is absent. Only flagship (how-to-lower-electric-bill-complete-guide) has image_alt set. Remaining 14 pages use article title as hero alt text — functional but non-descriptive for accessibility and image-SEO.

BODY IMAGE ALTS: 18 inline images found across pages with manual alt attributes — generally descriptive (e.g., 'Labeled water meter face diagram showing the red triangle leak indicator'), covering pages: electric-bill-breakdown, how-to-read-a-water-meter, water-meter-leak-indicator, water-meter-running, what-is-ccf, how-utility-rates, why-did-my-utility-bill-go-up, why-electric-bill-changes, average-utility-bills, 7-states, why-your-electric-bill-keeps-rising.

PRODUCT BOXES (CTA): Present on 8 of 15 pages: flagship (3 boxes), 03, 05, 07, 30-spike, 06-water, leak-indicator, water-meter-running. Absent on 01-read, 28-reconnection, 23-billing, sewer, ccf, avg-water, breakdown — these 7 have no CTA at end, representing missed monetization opportunity.

HERO VISUAL QUALITY: Per-page hero images exist but vary: 2 custom SVGs (sewer explosion diagram, energy-hogs-hero.webp bar chart) vs 13 generic hero-style illustrations — mostly stock-ish compositions with utility-themed imagery.

VISUAL GAPS: 13 of 15 pages lack a diagram/visual at the first diagnostic block — they rely on text tables. Only ccf and breakdown place inline diagrams at scroll position ~35-45% (first substantive content after Quick Answer).

MID-PAGE COMPLEXITY (bounce zone): All 15 pages have a data-heavy table or step list around scroll position 50-70% that would benefit from conversion to visual (comparison chart, timeline, or decision tree). Current: all are text tables with no SVG/Canvas/Chart replacements.
PER-PAGE SCROLL WALK SUMMARY TABLE available in artifact path.
IMAGE FILE DIVERSITY: 10.2MB total, 102 files (per IMAGE_AUDIT_REPORT.md). 91 articles have hero images. Utility characters (meters, bills, appliances) underrepresented in custom illustration style.
